rules: PES-13 is additive over PES-12; do not destructively rewrite historical records solely to normalize shape.
Existing Task priorities map for migration only: critical→P0, high→P1, medium→P2, low→P3.
If historical Task priority is absent and cannot be authoritatively recovered, migrate it as unassigned.
execution_order is not derived from priority unless an explicit project rule says so.
Git/GitHub is not required by PES Core.
A project-specific START-HERE/Help document may specialize the generic startup contract without changing PES semantics.
Verification and Acceptance remain distinct during migration.
A proposed Solution must not become selected without an attributable Decision.
Semantic hashing remains optional until a canonical serialization profile is separately frozen and test-vector-backed.
